title: Mixing: Café On The Left Bank, Name And Address, Famous Groupies by Wings | 1978
content:
AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Stereo mixes of three songs for Wings’ sixth studio album London Town were created on 5 January 1978.

Paul McCartney had overseen a mix of ‘Cafe On The Left Bank’ on the previous day. Unsure as to its merits, new mixes were created on this day, but McCartney eventually deemed the best mix from the 4 January session good enough for the album.

‘Name And Address’ and ‘Famous Groupies’ were then mixed in stereo. The day’s best mix of ‘Name And Address’ was used on London Town, but ‘Famous Groupies’ was remixed on 16 January.

Page last updated: 23 January 2026
